+def _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir: str, locale: str) -> str:
+    """Return the path to the Chromium locale pack for ``locale``."""
+    return os.path.join(locales_dir, locale + '.pak')
+
+
+def _normalize_locale(locale: str) -> str:
+    """Normalize a locale name to Chromium's hyphen-separated format."""
+    locale = locale.split('.', 1)[0].replace('_', '-')
+    parts = locale.split('-')
+    if not parts:
+        return locale
+
+    normalized = [parts[0].lower()]
+    for part in parts[1:]:
+        if len(part) == 2 or (len(part) == 3 and part.isdigit()):
+            normalized.append(part.upper())
+        elif len(part) == 4:
+            normalized.append(part.title())
+        else:
+            normalized.append(part)
+    return '-'.join(normalized)
+
+
+def _chromium_locale_fallback(locale: str) -> str:
+    """Map locales to the language packs Chromium uses for their region."""
+    parts = locale.split('-')
+    language = parts[0]
+    region = parts[-1].upper() if len(parts) > 1 else ''
+
+    if language == 'en':
+        if region in ('', 'US', 'LR', 'PH'):
+            return 'en-US'
+        return 'en-GB'
+
+    if language == 'es':
+        return 'es'
+
+    if language == 'pt':
+        if region in ('PT', 'AO', 'CV', 'GW', 'MO', 'MZ', 'ST', 'TL'):
+            return 'pt-PT'
+        return 'pt-BR'
+
+    if language == 'zh':
+        if region in ('TW', 'HK', 'MO'):
+            return 'zh-TW'
+        return 'zh-CN'
+
+    return language
+
+
+def _get_lang_override(
+        versions: version.WebEngineVersions,
+        locale: Optional[str] = None,
+        locales_dir: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return a Chromium ``--lang`` override if Qt's locale pack is missing.
+
+    QtWebEngine 5.15.3 crashes its network service when the system locale has
+    no corresponding locale pack. Chromium normally falls back to a supported
+    locale, so do that here for the affected QtWebEngine version.
+
+    ``locale`` and ``locales_dir`` can be provided directly to make the
+    fallback logic independent of the host running qutebrowser.
+    """
+    if (not config.val.qt.workarounds.locale or not utils.is_linux or
+            versions.webengine != utils.VersionNumber(5, 15, 3)):
+        return None
+
+    if locale is None:
+        locale = QLocale.system().name()
+    locale = _normalize_locale(locale)
+
+    if locales_dir is None:
+        locales_dir = os.environ.get('QTWEBENGINE_LOCALES_PATH')
+        if not locales_dir:
+            locales_dir = os.path.join(
+                QLibraryInfo.location(QLibraryInfo.TranslationsPath),
+                'qtwebengine_locales')
+
+    if os.path.exists(_get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, locale)):
+        return None
+
+    fallback = _chromium_locale_fallback(locale)
+    candidates = [fallback]
+    base_language = locale.split('-', 1)[0]
+    if base_language not in candidates:
+        candidates.append(base_language)
+
+    for candidate in candidates:
+        if candidate != locale and os.path.exists(
+                _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, candidate)):
+            return candidate
+
+    return 'en-US'
+
